3. It appears from materials on record that under SRO No.155 dated 12-6-91 customs duty for milk and cream concentrated or containing added sugar or other sweetening matter in powder form in retail packing of upto 2.5 Kg was 20% ad valorem and in powder form in bulk imported in bags was 40% ad volorem Under SRO No.157 dated 12-6-91 tariff value of tin packed full cream and half cream milk powder per Kg was Taka 90.00 and tariff value of fat free milk powder imported in bags per metric ton was Taka 55,125.00. By SRO No: 394 dated 24-12-91 customs duty on milk and cream concentrated or containing added sugar or other sweetening materials in powder form in retail packing  upto 2.5 Kg was increased to 25% ad valorem and in powder form in bulk imported in bags was increased to 45% ad valorem. By SRO No. ll dated 20-1-92 tariff value of full cream or half cream milk powder per Kg continued at Taka 90.00 and tariff value of fat free milk powder imported in bag also continued at Taka 55,125.00 but tariff value of full cream and half cream milk in powder form imported in bags was fixed at Taka 65,000.00 per metric ton. By SRO NO.152 dated 18"6-92 tariff value of full cream and half cream milk powder packed in tin per Kg was fixed US dollars 2.50 and tariff value of full cream and half cream milk in powder form imported in bags was fixed at US dollars 1900.00 per metric ton and fat free milk powder imported in bags was fixed at US dollars 1560. Under SRO NO.152 dated 18-6-92 customs duty on milk powder packed in tin upto 2.5 Kg was 25% ad valorem and packed in bags was 45% ad valorem. Under SRO No.1 13 dated 10-6-93 rate of customs duty on milk and cream concentrated or containing added sugar or other sweetening matter in powder form was 30%: ad valorem and in other form was 45% ad valorem. By subsequent SRO No.1 33 dated 6-7-93 customs duty on milk and cream concentrated or containing added sugar or other sweetening matter in powder form was increased to 45% ad valorem. By SRO No.214 dated 28-10-93 tariff value of milk powder imported in bulk in bags was increased to US dollars 1950.00. 

 15. In Writ Petition No.1931 of 1993 customs authority directed the petitioner to declare customs duty @ 45% on the basis of SRO No.133 dated 6-7-93 and tariff value per metric ton at US dollar 1950 on the basis of SRO No.214 dated 28-10-93. Petitioner opened Letter of Credit on 27-6-93 when customs duty for milk powder both packed in tins and bags was @ 30% ad valorem and, as such', he was not liable to pay customs duty @ 45% ad valorem on the basis of subsequent SRO dated 6-7-93. But he having not acquired any vested right to pay customs duty on the basis of tariff value of US dollar 1900 per metric ton as per SRO dated 18-6-92 he is not entitled to declare tariff value at US dollar 1900 per metric ton. We, therefore, find merit in part in this Rule and declare the demand of customs duty @45% instead Of 30% is without lawful authority and uphold the tariff value of US dollars 1950 per metric ton.
